method.interaction: Visible screenshots, visible HUD and handbook; keyboard/mouse JSON driver. No source, game-state hooks, prior reports, solutions, builds or tests consulted.

terminalOutcomes.progress: Recovered west archive, died trying to reach/recover heart while exposed to multiple enemies.
Recovered all memories, reached Custodian, disabled coil 1; last observed boss HUD coil 2 79%, coil 3 69%. Died during further firing. Extraction not reached.

observations.detail: Strong cohesive storm/industrial mood, reflective ground, cyan signage and large relay landmark. Menu and terminal result layouts read professionally.
Map, named destination markers, distance readout and recovery prompt made the mission discoverable. Resupply after memories sustained second attempt.
Deliberate optic aiming improved combat on second attempt; three critical eliminations recorded. Boss coil percentages and exposed/armored status supplied actionable feedback.

Receiving fire from several directions while locating receiver rings was hard to manage; damage accumulated quickly during stationary recovery/aiming. This includes player errors and missed shots, not evidence of unfairness or a defect.

Receiver reach is fairly strict: MOVE CLOSER at 3.4-4.1 m required further positioning; holding E outside reach did nothing except reminder. Floor ring and receiver can be below/behind the camera, so proximity alone did not settle alignment.

Close boss model silhouette and surrounding cover made identifying exposed copper targets harder from side views. I spent time orbiting/adjusting aim and taking other enemy fire. Only one coil disabled before death.
Small secondary text, muted hints, and multiple competing HUD elements require attention during combat. Main objective, ammo and health were much easier to scan.
Visible title identifies BUILD 43 despite report requested as build44; no inference about actual code version.

driverErrors: text=ENTER THE STORM click was ambiguous (two matching elements); corrected using visible deploy-label selector. Raw error preserved sequence 4.
errorsAndMisses.playerErrors: Missed guard and interceptor shots, attempted recovery outside reach, exposed traversal and imperfect boss aim retained in full action log. No attempts discarded.
errorsAndMisses.pageErrors: No page errors reported by driver results.

ratingRationale: A coherent and learnable vertical slice with good mission scaffolding and appealing atmosphere. Combat is engaging enough to try a changed approach, but target/close boss clarity, HUD density, simple blocklike actors and limited observed encounter breadth keep AAA readiness low. Ratings reflect these two attempts only.
limitations: Exactly two deaths; no completed extraction, successful ending, or full boss disable observed.
JSON action batches and pause screenshots differ from continuous human mouse play; low recorded accuracy is substantially reviewer input/aim limitation.
Audio, human enjoyment, hardware performance and renderer backend unvalidated. Driver software-WebGL fallback message does not certify backend.
No balance claims from two attempts; no debug/source inspection.
